note: Barnes County Park Board campground in the 545-acre Clausen Springs Wildlife Management Area, 4.5 mi west and 1.5 mi south of Kathryn off ND-1, around Clausen Springs Lake. The electric sites sit in wooded loops along the spring creek near the camp host; the more secluded non-electric sites, marked for small campers and tents, are scattered across the grassland. Swim area (no lifeguard), fishing dock with kayak launch, boat ramp, playground and a 2-mile lake loop; the North Country Trail follows the park's north edge. Game and Fish rules apply: no ATVs, snowmobiles or metal detecting, no fireworks, and the WMA is open to hunting in season. --Claude
